xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Period - FY 2015-16,FY 2016-17 and Apr 2017-Jun 2017 Issue - Non-Inclusion of Freight charged to customers in the assessable value for determination of Excise Duty liability in respect of Ex-Works Sales. The jursidrictional office demanded the differential Excise Duty considering inclusion of outward Freight in the Assessable value along with applicable Penalty. The Company has filed an Appeal with CESTAT in respect of the same and awaits the hearing. Quantum of Claims - Rs. 172 Mn
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is still pending and there is no change.
